segments.title: How fast can a WILD turkey fly?
segments.say: How fast can a wild turkey fly? It can't fly, fifteen miles an hour, or fifty-five? Comment your guess. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Up to 55 mph!
segments.say: Up to fifty-five miles an hour! Wild turkeys really do fly.

segments.title: They RUN 25 mph too
segments.say: And they can run up to twenty-five miles an hour.

segments.title: At night they sleep in TREES
segments.say: At sundown they fly up into the trees and hop branch to branch to a high roost.
Follow for Weird Animal number 19 tomorrow.
